lr2.issue.contentTikTokPost.en: Meta takes Facebook or Instagram posts or finished clips, not TikTok posts.
lr2.issue.contentTikTokPost.zh: Meta 使用 Facebook 或 Instagram 帖子或成片切片，不使用 TikTok 帖子。

ltc.choose.en: Choose Studio clips or TikTok posts
ltc.choose.zh: 选择 Studio 切片或 TikTok 帖子

ltc.chooseHint.en: Each Studio clip becomes an ad by itself: Studio uploads it and runs it as your TikTok account. Nothing to post in the app, no codes to copy.
ltc.chooseHint.zh: 每个 Studio 切片直接成为一条广告：Studio 会上传它，并以你的 TikTok 账号投放。无需在 App 里发布，也无需复制授权码。

ltc.clipsRunAs.en: Studio uploads each clip you pick and runs it as {handle}, shown only as an ad: it plays in the For You feed under {handle}'s name and picture, and never appears on the profile. The Monitor links to each ad on TikTok once it exists.
ltc.clipsRunAs.zh: 你选的每个切片都会由 Studio 上传，并以 {handle} 的身份投放，只作为广告展示：它会以 {handle} 的名称和头像出现在“推荐”信息流中，不会出现在主页上。广告创建后，监控页会给出每条广告在 TikTok 上的链接。

ltc.clipsCannotPush.en: {handle} is linked to this ad account, but Business Center does not let ads upload videos to it. Its posts can still run; to use Studio clips, give the ad account permission to run ads with new videos on {handle} in Business Center.
ltc.clipsCannotPush.zh: {handle} 已关联到这个广告账户，但商务中心不允许广告向它上传视频。它的帖子仍可投放；如需使用 Studio 切片，请在商务中心为这个广告账户开通用新视频以 {handle} 投放广告的权限。

ltc.clipsRunAsLinked.en: Studio uploads each clip you pick and runs it as the TikTok account Business Center links to the ad account, shown only as an ad (never on the profile).
ltc.clipsRunAsLinked.zh: 你选的每个切片都会由 Studio 上传，并以商务中心关联到该广告账户的 TikTok 账号投放，只作为广告展示（不会出现在主页上）。

ltc.postsFrom.en: Posts of the account linked to
ltc.postsFrom.zh: 读取以下广告账户关联账号的帖子

ltc.postsHint.en: Posts {handle} has already made. Each one you add runs as an ad as it is, with no Spark code; it stays on the profile.
ltc.postsHint.zh: {handle} 已发布的帖子。你添加的每个帖子都会原样作为广告投放，无需 Spark 授权码；帖子仍保留在主页上。

ltc.postsMore.zh: 显示最新的 {n} 个帖子。

ltc.rowsHint.en: Each row is one ad. A Studio clip promotes its own title and carries the line TikTok shows under it; a post or a Spark code starts on the launch's title (step 4) and can promote another. One launch can promote several titles.
ltc.rowsHint.zh: 每一行是一条广告。Studio 切片推广它自己的剧集，并带有 TikTok 显示在视频下方的文字；帖子或 Spark 授权码默认推广本次投放的剧集（第 4 步），也可以改为其他剧集。一次投放可以推广多部剧集。

ltc.adTextFor.en: Text under the video of ad {n}
ltc.adTextFor.zh: 第 {n} 条广告视频下方的文字

ltc.runsAsClips.en: {n} Studio clips run as {handle}, shown only as ads (not on the profile).
ltc.runsAsClips.zh: {n} 个 Studio 切片以 {handle} 的身份投放，只作为广告展示（不在主页上）。

ltc.runsAsClipsOne.en: 1 Studio clip runs as {handle}, shown only as an ad (not on the profile).
ltc.runsAsClipsOne.zh: 1 个 Studio 切片以 {handle} 的身份投放，只作为广告展示（不在主页上）。

ltc.runsAsPosts.en: {n} posts of {handle} run as ads, with no Spark code.
ltc.runsAsPosts.zh: {handle} 的 {n} 个帖子作为广告投放，无需 Spark 授权码。

ltc.runsAsPostsOne.en: 1 post of {handle} runs as an ad, with no Spark code.
ltc.runsAsPostsOne.zh: {handle} 的 1 个帖子作为广告投放，无需 Spark 授权码。

ltc.watchHint.en: TikTok's own preview of this ad, exactly as it runs (opens in a new tab)
ltc.watchHint.zh: TikTok 对这条广告的官方预览，与实际投放完全一致（在新标签页打开）

ltc.runsAsAdsOnly.en: Runs as {handle} · only as an ad, not on the profile
ltc.runsAsAdsOnly.zh: 以 {handle} 的身份投放 · 只作为广告，不在主页上

ltc.ownerPost.en: Its post (only the account owner sees it)
ltc.ownerPost.zh: 对应的帖子（仅账号本人可见）

ltc.ownerPostHint.en: The post TikTok made for this ad. It opens for the account's owner, signed in, and for nobody else.
ltc.ownerPostHint.zh: TikTok 为这条广告生成的帖子。只有登录后的账号本人能打开，其他人看不到。

ltc.sparkUnknown.en: TikTok does not recognise this code: {reason}
ltc.sparkUnknown.zh: TikTok 无法识别这个授权码：{reason}
